package.description: Recreate missing WinGet command aliases for portable packages.

en-US.description: Recreate missing WinGet command aliases for portable packages.
en-US.longDescription:
syncwingetlink detects portable packages installed with winget, compares them with
the expected WinGet Links directory, and recreates missing or broken command-alias
symlinks.
en-US.name: syncwingetlink
